title: Exploring Muslim Travelers' Intentions to Visit Non-Muslim Tourist Destinations
core_idea: Address a research gap on Muslim travelers' intentions to visit non-Muslim areas in Indonesia by integrating the Theory of Planned Behavior with the marketing mix to examine psychological and marketing determinants of travel decision-making, using an online questionnaire and multiple regression analysis.
tldr: This study investigates what influences Indonesian Muslim travelers' intentions to visit non-Muslim tourist destinations by combining psychological (TPB) and marketing (4Ps) perspectives and analyzing survey data from 361 respondents.
